description: Phase 0/1 short sweep: v0_reference vs v1_naive, a handful of representative shapes. Run by scripts/run_benchmarks.py; every point is correctness-checked against v0_reference before it is timed (a failing correctness check aborts that point rather than emitting a BenchResult). Kept intentionally short (5 shape points x 2 variants, reps=20 -- the schema's stated minimum) for Phase 0/1 evidence; the full sequence-length/head-dim sweep this project's benchmark plan (spec SS1.8) calls for is built out starting Phase 2 (memory accounting) once there is a tiled variant to compare against.
